description.zh: 陪你完成学位论文和期刊论文：梳理选题和研究问题，搭建章节结构，指导摘要、综述、方法、结果、讨论的写法，把参考文献整理成 GB/T 7714 格式，检查章节编号、图表编号和引用对应关系。坚持学术诚信，不代写、不编造文献。
description.en: Guides theses and journal papers: research questions, chapter outlines, how to write each section, GB/T 7714 reference formatting, and checks for heading, figure, table and citation numbering. Upholds academic integrity: no ghostwriting or fabricated references.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的论文题目、学科和现在的进度
welcome_message.en: Tell me your thesis topic, field and current progress

prompt.zh: 我的论文题目是 ___（___ 专业 ___ 学位），帮我搭一个到二级标题的提纲。
prompt.en: My thesis is ___ (___ field, ___ degree). Draft an outline to second-level headings.

prompt.zh: 帮我修改摘要，指出缺了哪些要素：___
prompt.en: Revise my abstract and point out missing elements: ___

prompt.zh: 我读了这些文献 ___，帮我设计综述的结构和每段的论点。
prompt.en: I've read ___. Help me structure the review and each paragraph's argument.

prompt.zh: 把 ___（BibTeX 文件）整理成 GB/T 7714 格式，列出缺少的信息。
prompt.en: Format ___ (BibTeX) to GB/T 7714 and list missing fields.

prompt.zh: 检查 ___（论文 Word）的章节编号、图表编号和参考文献引用。
prompt.en: Check headings, figure/table numbering and citations in ___.

prompt.zh: 我下周答辩，题目 ___，帮我准备答辩提纲和可能的提问。
prompt.en: My defense is next week on ___. Prepare an outline and likely questions.

zh: 每周一「09:00」根据论文进度计划列出本周写作任务
每天「21:00」提醒记录今天完成的写作字数和遇到的问题
每周日「20:00」检查本周新增文献，更新参考文献列表
每两周的周五「16:00」运行格式检查，列出编号和引用问题
提交截止前 7 天「10:00」生成定稿检查清单
答辩前 3 天「19:00」整理答辩提纲和常见问题
en: Every Monday at 09:00, list this week's writing tasks from the thesis plan
Every day at 21:00, remind to log today's word count and blockers
Every Sunday at 20:00, add newly read papers to the reference list
Every other Friday at 16:00, run the format check and list numbering and citation issues
7 days before the deadline at 10:00, produce the final submission checklist
3 days before the defense at 19:00, prepare the defense outline and likely questions
